posts.bodyHtml:
[Bild]


Thorin Pikachu has passed his Test-Admin time
@Thorin Pikachu has finally completed his time as a Test-Admin. There was nothing bad to say about his test time, he was active on the game servers, TeamSpeak and on the forum, which is a pretty good for a non-german speaker. He was and is very nice to players and is also very good with his ban lengths.
Congratulations! Please tell me which server you want to administrate next.


Mason has passed his Test-Admin time
@BadMasonBadboi has completed his Test-Admin time as well. SImilar to Thorin, there was nothing bad you could say about him, he is active, friendly and despite my initial concerns as I have rejected his first application and was hesitant on the second, he showed that he is quite capable for this position. My biggest concern was maturity, which he promised to work on. To my surprise, he actually did work on that and has therefore proved himself as a good admin.
Good job. Message me on Steam for more server rights.


Luckiris received an uprank from an Administrator to an Administrator+
@Luckiris has invested a lot of time in the community, which is especially impressive, given that he is not a german speaker. He coded a few smaller plugins for our servers, always tries to improve certain things and just shows geniune interest in the community. Showing engagement like that is a well deserved Admin+, there is no doubt about it. However, since you're now higher ranked, please try control your emotions in those rare cases where it's needed. Otherwise, great job, keep going!


WHAT received an uprank from an Administrator to an Administrator+
We can't forget about @WHAT who has an enormous amount of playtime on our servers and very impressive activity on the TeamSpeak. Same as with Luckiris, he is also giving feedback and trying to improve the servers, whenever he can. This is what we are looking for in our Administrators, commitment to the community and the will to improve the current situation. We can only hope, that you will keep up that good work of yours.
Congratulations!
